text: Did the new ep drop or am I going crazy
it dropped at 6 this morning i'm driving home tonight so i'll listen then
Ok good. I'm grading lab reports til like 5 so no spoilers
no spoilers (wait what do u mean by lab reports is that a threat
Ha. They're titration write-ups. 14 of them and half say "the solution turned pink" with no volume
omg. kids
client just called to say the sample swatches are "too sad." the sample swatches are from the ORDER SHE PICKED
Oof. What did you say
said "they're the colors you chose" in the nicest voice i have. she wants me to come back out thursday and "feel the room"
Feel the room
Home. The pink reports are done
ur a hero. still in traffic on 85 ugh
home. ok i'm listening now. dont text me
Ok
Did the ep bother you. The injuries part. I kept thinking about the second victim's hands and I'm not sure if that's normal
honestly yeah i had to pause it and go wash dishes. i kept picturing it. is that weird
No. I think it's fine. I'm not sure if I'm bothered or just can't stop reading the autopsy part
i'm both the killer's voice in the interview part made my skin crawl more than the actual injuries tbh
Yeah. He sounds so reasonable
right?? like he's explaining it like a recipe. i was like ok stop
The chemist in me kept wanting to check his timeline
of course u did
ok i'm gonna sleep or i'll be up thinking about it. night
Night
ok i slept like 4 hrs. his voice is still in my head
Same. Coffee helped a little
Did you eat or are you doing the thing where you just drink coffee and leave
coffee and half a granola bar. the thing
Rachel
ok ok i have a banana in the car
client emailed the swatches again. now she wants to see "warmer options" but in the same colors. like the warmth is supposed to just appear
Can you send her a warmth sheet
i am not sending her a warmth sheet i'm going to make a very nice folder and say "per our conversation"
That's the most passive aggressive thing I've ever heard and I approve
ur gonna be a mean principal one day
I'm a chemistry teacher. I'm already mean
Lab reports are back in the bin, 9 of 14 say "pink" again. I'm starting to think it's a cult
lmaooo the pink cult
u still going to be up late grading or u done for real
Done for real. Making dinner. Eggs and something green
ur doing ur best
hey did u finish the ep or did u stop at the autopsy part
Stopped. I'm not going to finish it tonight
yeah. same. i'm gonna do something dumb like rewatch the new mexico show
Ok. Lock the door
i always lock the door 🙄
You always say that and then you're on the phone with the door open
ok fair. night dani
Did you ever hear back from her about Thursday
she texted "see you at 10 xx" like nothing happened. so yes?? she's coming to Thursday like its a date
Good luck. Text me when you're out
will do
ok the folder is done. it has a cover page
Of course it does
Morning. Did you eat
yes. toast. standing up but it counts
in the room. she's already here. she brought a candle
A candle
a candle dani. to feel the room
Morning block. Kid cracked a burette and sliced his thumb open. Nurse took him, I did the paper towel thing. Thumb's fine, I think. My hands are still doing a thing
oh no. is he ok
Stitches maybe. He was more embarrassed than hurt. Kept apologizing to the floor
He's 15
ur the best teacher. sorry about ur hands 💕
ok the candle is lavender and she keeps saying "i want the room to breathe" and i'm writing "breathe" on a legal pad like it's a clue
Lol. Breathe
Did the kid's mom call. I'm supposed to write up the incident and I don't know what to put for "cause"
Put "glassware." I'm going with glassware
leaving now. she wants to walk to the window one more time. it's the same window
Ok
out. i'm in the car. she hugged me which was not in the contract
Did she say anything about the swatches
she said she trusts my eye now. which is either a compliment or a threat
Compliment. Your eye is good
dani ur sweet ok im going home and eating something green. ur rubbing off
Bell just rang. Bin of 14 lab reports on my desk and the incident form. Going to be here a while
ur a hero twice in one week. ill send u a candle emoji as a sympathy gift
home. did u finish the write up
Finished. Put "glassware" and a smiley face. The office didn't love it
it's perfect
Hands are fine now. Had a glass of wine and I'm done thinking about burettes
good. ur allowed to be done
i'm not listening to the ep tonight. i think im gonna take a break from it for a while
Ok. That's probably smart
i'm on the couch w the door locked i checked twice
Good. Text me when you're in bed
will do. night dani
Night
